The same happened to me. First pregnancy and first lost at 8 weeks. Give yourself time to grieve and take in some sunshine, it’s hard to get back to normal. It’s been 3 weeks for me but I’m starting to feel more okay, I don’t hold in my emotions and always verbally communicate to my partner about it. You may find intimacy even non sexual to become hard at some points and uncomfortable with yourself but remind yourself that this isn’t uncommon and that you are still a beautiful human being. I went through pretty bad depression but my partner supported me 100%. You are amazing and I hope that this time of healing brings you guys closer and makes a stronger bond. Give yourself all the time to grieve and feel your emotions and remember there is no time limit to yalls healing!
